name: How long do I have to file a dog bite claim in California?

mainEntity.name: How long do I have to file a dog bite claim in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: In California, the statute of limitations for personal injury claims, including dog bites, is generally two years from the date of the injury. This means you typically have two years from the day you were bitten to file a lawsuit in court. If you miss this deadline, you may lose your right to pursue compensation entirely. There can be exceptions to this rule, such as if the victim is a minor, so it's critical to consult with an attorney as soon as possible to ensure your claim is filed within the proper timeframe.
